The text touches upon themes attested across the Pali canon, being noted in connection with the *Arakkheyyasutta* (AN 7.58), the *Saṅgīti Sutta* (DN 33 / PTS DN iii 207), and the Vinaya *Bhikkhuvibhaṅga* on the first *Pārājika* (Bu-Vb Pj 1) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records three translations of the text in three modern languages [SuttaCentral].
